This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

Expressiveness ideas:

2. Add an inner question to show his motivation more vividly, such as 他想：“这些植物到底能不能吃？”

ideas.reason: It adds a fitting feeling after Shen Nong sees people become sick.
It adds a natural inner question that supports his wish to identify edible plants.
